page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note at the left beside the second line. The page has a running head at the top and a page number at the top left. Ends with a word running on to the next page.

main_text.p: » succedendo prohiberi uidetur rumpere, quàm qui iam natus erit. Denique & supe-riore capite, ut liceat institui nondum natos, qui cum na-per-mittat. » scentur fui erunt, *permitti. » posteriore capite non permittit institui, sed uetat rum-pi, neue ob eam rem minus ratum esset quòd succedit. » Porrò procedere debet, ut utiliter sit institutus. quod » nullo iure potuit, qui non- » dum natus erat. Juliano ta- » men;uideretur, duob. quasi » capitibus legis commixtis, » in hoc quoque inducere le-gè,ne rūpantur testamenta. » In

page.notes: The marginal note "per-mittat." is printed beside the line "scentur fui erunt, *permitti.", with an asterisk marking "permitti". The word "ne'ue" was read as "neue". The line-initial "»" marks are printed on every line and were copied as they stand. The running head and the page number are hard to read; the head is partly illegible. The final word "In" is a fragment that continues on the next page. The word "rum-pi" is printed with a line-end hyphen, so the word was joined as "rumpi" in the transcription; check this if the hyphen was a real one.
